 GTA 6: Where to Find Strip Clubs
 By Adam Beck Nov 18, 2026, 4:48 PM EST Adam Beck is a Canadian who has covered the gaming industry for over twenty years. He has a passion for RPGs, action, stealth and horror games.
 Welcome back to Vice City 
 Explore Our Coverage 
 → 
 Who doesn’t like to party a little in games? Well, 
 Grand Theft Auto 6 
 certainly has various means to do so. Whether it’s a club, a fancy VIP 
 experience, or a traditional strip club, Vice City has everything you’re 
 looking for. 
 This has been a staple of the series ever since Grand Theft Auto 3, as 
 going into these clubs not only facilitated story missions but also 
 allowed the characters (and the player) to get an NSFW experience. There 
 are a handful of different options in Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto 6, but 
 finding them can be a bit tricky. Most of them are centralized, and some 
 you won’t see until much later in the campaign.

 Delights Cabaret
 The first strip club you’ll find is in Chapter 2 upon meeting Vicki who 
 will introduce you to her boss at the Delights Cabaret. This is a 
 traditional strip club, but one that’s more in line with being out in 
 the middle of nowhere. It’s more of a bar atmosphere with girls in the 
 back. 
 With that said, you’ll be able to find Delights Cabaret in the Port 
 Gellhorn section of the map, all the way to the west. 
 Jack of Hearts
 The first strip club you’ll come across in Vice City is part of the 
 story between Jason and his old buddy Dre’Quan. He will invite you out 
 to his club, where he will introduce you to Boobie, who will be putting 
 Jason and Lucia up in his apartment. 
 This is a traditional strip club, with dancers on poles. It’s also one 
 of the more expensive clubs, with VIP dance treatments costing $1,000. 
 Jack of Hearts is located in central Crosstown, just south of your 
 apartment. This is the go-to spot for adult entertainment. 
 NINE1NINE
 This has more of a club vibe with a bit of stripping. It’s far fancier 
 than Jack of Hearts, but has just as many options, if not more, with 
 dancing on the dancefloor. The best part is that the VIP dances will 
 only set you back $300 in-game. 
 NINE1NINE is south of Jack of Hearts, at the top of the Downtown section 
 of the map. Even when you roll up to the place for the first time, 
 you’ll notice just how much nicer it is, with a more exclusive feeling. 
 The Vault
 This is less of a strip club and more of a dance club. At least one main 
 mission takes place here, and it’s probably the best place to go dancing 
 with Lucia. It features multiple rooms with different types of music and 
 DJs, and its aesthetic is built around an old vault, with a giant vault 
 door at the entrance. 
 It’s definitely somewhere to check out in Vice City, and thankfully, 
 it’s right across the street from NINE1NINE, just to the west. 
 VYB
 Last but not least is VYB. It’s located in the northeast portion of 
 Ocean Beach, directly south of your Act 4 home in Washington Beach. 
 Similar to The Vault, it has a more traditional club atmosphere, with 
 dance floors and high-class bars in the back. 
 Unfortunately, VYB isn’t accessible to the public, as it’s part of 
 Dre’Quan’s lengthy story and is only used during a main mission in Act 
 4. With that said, it’s probably the nicest club in the game.
